name: 90north-develop
description: North's development plugin: three loops on one discipline. workflow: the map — routes work to the right flow and holds the shared stages (isolate, review + QA, evidence video, ship, learn) and the Jira REST scripts. dev-loop: a story, task or spec from ready to reviewed PR — ready check, n-dev design note with a gate for Large or schema/interface changes, acceptance spec red first, work packages built test-first by dev-builder subagents, review + QA, inline demo video, 3-part Jira comment, review lane. defect-loop: sweeps the Jira defect board — triage, red e2e repro, root cause at path:line, test-first fix, review + QA, before/after videos inline, 3-part comment, QA lane. n-loop: the unattended flow for any project — follows up its own questions and PRs, locks the next card of the AI queue, triages any card type against the n-arch profile, proves the card's own spec red then green through the defect or dev path, has loop-verifier refute every claim, ships by policy (auto-merge only inside a standing approval, else review, or the solution posted) and learns into project knowledge with loop-learner. n-dev: how every change is written (design first, modular, reuse, extension files, one owner per fact, test-first, verified), with a structure check for layers, weakened tests and new dependencies. n-arch: captures each repo's architecture as a profile plus the .ndev.toml rules the check enforces, and audits structural debt. Every loop reaches the tracker through one door (tracker.sh): Jira, or a local board of markdown cards in the repo when there is no Jira. Project facts live in each repo's .claude/90north-develop/, written by /90north-develop:develop-init.
